the combination of cold pressing and supercritical extraction of hemp oil is a very promising method to obtain a high quality hemp seed oil with a good content of unsaturated fatty acids.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the oil extracted from Cannabis sativa seed is rich in unsaturated fatty acids (linoleic acid 55.2%, α-linolenic acid 18.2%) and is a good source of tocopherols (α-tocopherol 2.8 mg/100 g, γ-tocopherol, 0.8 mg/ 100 g).
cold pressing of hemp seed is an effective way to obtain high quality oil, while the supercritical CO2 can be used to extract residual oil in the hemp seed cake.
supercritical extraction is a viable alternative to the conventional methods for the recovery of oil from the hemp seed press cake.
